groups.A: Read what the workload really needs (dynamic vs static, prod vs Spot, root cause)
groups.B: Edge & DNS (CloudFront geo-restriction, Global Accelerator + public alias)
groups.C: Hybrid networking (dedicated private links = Direct Connect)
groups.D: Governance & app identity (Config vs GuardDuty, Cognito for mobile federation)

53.keywords: INTERACTIVE web system, NGINX + MySQL, load balancer required, most efficient
53.trap: 🔁 Same question missed in the 10-14 marathon: S3 only serves static files (can't run NGINX logic), and the option points Route 53 at an ELB it never creates
53.rule: Dynamic app + DB → EC2 in 2 AZs + DMS + ELB + Route 53 alias. Reject options with a step that contradicts another step.

70.keywords: S3 static website, alias record created, users see no content
70.trap: 'Wait 12 hours for propagation' — Route 53 propagates in ~60 s; waiting is never the fix
70.rule: S3 website returns nothing → bucket policy must allow public s3:GetObject (and Block Public Access off). Fix the real cause, never 'just wait'.

10.keywords: flagship product page, highly available, 300,000 peak users, cost-effective
10.trap: Spot Instances can be reclaimed — not for the always-on production web tier
10.rule: Production HA web tier → ASG of On-Demand EC2 behind ALB + Aurora Multi-AZ (retain on delete). Spot only for interruptible work.

39.keywords: 500 GB static dataset at boot, scale in/out, deploy code several times a day, patch within 48 h
39.trap: User data downloading 500 GB from S3 on every launch makes scale-out slow; patching live instances drifts from the AMI
39.rule: Patch → bake new AMI (SSM) → replace instances; shared static data → mount EFS; app updates → CodeDeploy.

68.keywords: report files must NOT be accessible in listed countries, global low latency
68.trap: 🔁 Route 53 geolocation only ROUTES by location — it does not block (same miss as the 10-13 Pair drill)
68.rule: Block countries → CloudFront geo restriction (or WAF geo match). Route 53 geolocation = routing, not access control.

59.keywords: multi-Region ALBs, apex domain, public DNS, most operationally efficient
59.trap: Twin options: Resolver INBOUND endpoint is for on-prem → AWS private DNS queries, not public records
59.rule: Global Accelerator in front of regional ALBs + Route 53 public ALIAS record (apex OK) to the accelerator DNS name.

22.keywords: many VPCs in many Regions ↔ on-prem, private DEDICATED network, predictable performance
22.trap: 🔁 Site-to-Site VPN runs over the internet — not dedicated (same miss as the 10-13 Pair drill)
22.rule: Dedicated private connectivity to many VPCs/Regions → Direct Connect + DX Gateway + private VIF (VGW per VPC).

21.keywords: latest patches, check approved AMIs, must NOT impede developers, notify
21.trap: 🔁 GuardDuty detects threats (malicious activity), not patch level or AMI compliance
21.rule: Patching → SSM Patch Manager baseline. Detect non-approved AMI without blocking → AWS Config managed rule approved-amis-by-id + alert.

45.keywords: mobile app, custom-built authentication, federated access, IAM roles for permissions
45.trap: IAM Identity Center is for workforce SSO to accounts/business apps, not mobile app federation
45.rule: Custom auth for a mobile app → custom SAML IdP + IAM SAML provider, or custom OIDC + Cognito Identity Pools (temp creds via IAM roles).
